title: Kale Salad with Grilled Chicken
description: A refreshing salad made with grilled chicken, crispy kale, and a tangy medley of vegetables.

ingredients.name: Kale
ingredients.amount: 2 cups, stems removed and discarded, leaves chopped

ingredients.name: Medley of Vegetables (bell peppers, cucumbers, carrots)

instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper. Grill for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
In a large bowl, massage the chopped kale with olive oil and salt to make it crispy.
Add the sliced grilled chicken, medley of vegetables, and tartar sauce to the bowl with the kale.
